mapper.select: SELECT id, name, lifecycle, status, user_status AS userStatus, member_id AS memberId, (journey_rules_json IS NOT NULL) AS hasRules, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM theme_state_key k WHERE k.topic_id = t.id) AS stateKeyCount, update_time AS updateTime FROM cms_topic t WHERE del_flag = 0 AND id = #{topicId} AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_topic SET journey_rules_json = #{json}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND journey_rules_json <=> #{expected}
